text:
priya_sales: Heads-up — Enterprise POC (EU bank) hit a blocker. They pinned model `redwood-enterprise-1.4` but calls return model-not-available in eu-west. Also flagged security questionnaire items (KMS, audit logs). Can eng + SRE swarm?

josh_seals: Ugh. Do we have logs or error IDs? Customer is mid-demo tomorrow. Need quick triage + temporary workaround.

maya_oncall: I can jump on this. From earlier cases, likely either model not yet deployed to eu region or the pinned version was deprecated on hosted catalog. Can you paste the error payload?

priya_sales: Pasting verbatim from their client: 
```
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "model_not_available_in_region",
  "model": "redwood-enterprise-1.4",
  "region": "eu-west-1",
  "request_id": "req_01GZ..."
}
```
They also tried with a pinned model alias and got 429 after retries.

josh_seals: 404 + 429 combo suggests fallback routing kicked in then got throttled. @raj_sre can you check quota + x-rate-limit headers for that org id?

raj_sre: Looking now — the org hit the hosted free-tier burst cap in eu-west. Headers from our edge for one sample request: 
```
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-reset: 45
status: 429
```
We also show the model isn't in the eu pool for that exact build tag.

priya_sales: They want to keep the exact pinned model for compliance. Are there options to map a pin to a compatible variant that is available in eu?

evon_eng: (evan_eng) We can create a temporary model alias that points `redwood-enterprise-1.4` to `redwood-enterprise-1.4-eu-compatible` which is a binary-identical serving variant built for EU infra. That requires a private mapping change on our control plane — I can do it, but needs approval from product/security owners because of versioning semantics. ETA ~2 hours.

josh_seals: If mapping takes too long, is golden path fallback acceptable? e.g., ask customer to pin to `redwood-enterprise-1.3` which is available in eu? We need to give them exact commands for demo.

maya_oncall: Quick workaround for demo: set request header `X-Region: global` to route to hosted global pool where the model exists (latency tradeoff). Or configure `fallback_model` in request body: 
```json
{"model":"redwood-enterprise-1.4","fallback_model":"redwood-enterprise-1.3-eu","prompt":"..."}
```
That avoids control-plane alias but requires customer change.

priya_sales: They're also asking about Dedicated vs Hosted pricing: if we spin a dedicated trial in eu for them, how long to stand up and cost delta? Need numbers for procurement.

evon_eng: Dedicated trial (small pool) can be provisioned in 48-72 hours for EU with on-boarding support. Price uplift ~3x hosted for reserved pool depending on GPU type; we can get an exact quote from finance — tagging @josh_seals to escalate.

raj_sre: Also: security questionnaire — they want KMS + audit logs + encryption at rest. Hosted supports customer-managed KMS for Private deployments only; for Hosted we offer envelope encryption with our KMS and audit logs retention add-on. I can compile the precise bullet points for the questionnaire.

priya_sales: Can we do two parallel actions: (1) Evan prepares alias mapping for immediate swap if security signs off, (2) Maya/raj open a temporary quota bump for the org to avoid 429s during demo, (3) give the customer the fallback snippet for the demo?

maya_oncall: Affirmative — opening quota escalation request to infra now. If approved, can bump for 4 hours.

evon_eng: I'll draft the alias change and the security justification. If security requires an audit trail for aliasing, we'll log every mapping change and produce a signed artifact.

josh_seals: I'll send the pricing ballpark and request procurement to fast-track the PO. Also sharing demo-friendly fallback instructions to the customer: short snippet + note about latency.

priya_sales: Awesome — can we confirm back here when alias is ready or quota bump is approved? Demo is at 14:00 CET.

deploy-bot: deployment request 2026-03-21T11:15:23Z queued: quota-bump/eu-west/org-9876 — awaiting approvals.

raj_sre: Quota bump sent to infra approvers. ETA ~30-60 min.

josh_seals: Customer updated: they'll try `fallback_model` option first, but keep us posted on alias + quota. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

priya_sales: Great work. Follow-ups: 1) Evan — alias PR and security note, 2) Maya/Raj — quota + headers, 3) Josh — pricing + PO chase. Ping me if anything blocks the 14:00 demo.

maya_oncall: Will post final status here once infra approves.

evon_eng: Draft ready, pushing change to control plane after security sign-off.

priya_sales: End of thread for now — will reopen if demo hits anything else.
